edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online: the slow answers his step-up, but his bounce poke keeps range — even trades around spacing.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E unlocks the real combo: Flux-root him before the satchel hop and Q-E-Q punishes his lack of a dash.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: Maxed Bouncing Bomb and Minefield out-poke your walk-ups — 850-range bombs every 4-6s. Farm what is free.

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.
edits.after: RoA spike: the HP stops his poke chunking you and your combo takes half bars. Now force the trades you avoided.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ bursts him before the satchel, W stops his hop, warps win every siege.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rune Prison like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, 12s max — his only escape; he is catchable for exactly that long. - Minefield: flat 16s — walk up after he zones a wave with it. - Guard your W Rune Prison like a fifth summoner spell; the ultimate goes to kill windows.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: His Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1 — sidestep a bounce and you have a free E-Q answer before the next one lands.

edits.before: Your root is your only 'stop' button — a W spent poking is a Zed mark you can't answer.
edits.after: Your root is your only 'stop' button — hold it to beat the satchel hop, never spend it on poke.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: His combo opens with a Short Fuse auto reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back out of range.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP extends the map game. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rune Prison like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — his 20s knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rune Prison like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
